name: Zari Anarkali Set
desc: A regal flared anarkali with an intricate woven zari lattice, paired with a matching churidar and scalloped net dupatta with delicate hand-finished sitara work.

name: Bandhani Kurta Set
desc: Authentic artisanal tie-dyed dots in ivory on rich madder red, with a flattering straight kurta, fluid palazzo and lightweight zari-bordered dupatta.

name: Chanderi Straight Kurta
desc: Featherlight, translucent gold Chanderi accented with fine jewel-wine pin-stripes. Versatile for boardroom morning to festive evening gatherings.

name: Banarasi Silk Saree
desc: Deep royal aubergine silk masterfully woven with an all-over antique gold jaali weave and a majestic temple border with tassels.

name: Block Print Cotton Saree
desc: Ultra-soft Mulmul cotton stamped by master artisans with delicate wine and terracotta botanical blooms. Comes with an unstitched printed blouse piece.

name: Embroidered Lehenga
desc: A breathtaking 16-kali raw silk lehenga with heavy antique gold zardozi threadwork, a fitted sweetheart-neck blouse, and an ethereal sheer scalloped veil dupatta.

name: Satin Slip Midi Dress
desc: A liquid wine bias-cut midi dress with a fluid drape that moves with you. Features delicate adjustable French straps and an alluring side leg slit.

name: Crepe Wrap Dress
desc: Deep espresso structured crepe woven with whisper-thin gold pinstripes. A genuine wrap silhouette that can be tied to custom-contour your waistline.

name: Linen Tailored Blazer
desc: A sharp single-breasted sartorial blazer in sand houndstooth check, tailored with peaked lapels and horn buttons. Half-lined for breathable daylong comfort.

name: Silk Camisole
desc: A minimalist camisole cut in radiant champagne sand-washed silk. Drapes effortlessly beneath blazers or worn solo on sunlit afternoons.

name: Wide-Leg Trousers
desc: High-waisted, pleated palazzo-cut trousers in deep roasted espresso. Designed with deep slash pockets and an elongated straight leg line.

name: Silk Palazzo Set
desc: A golden honey-hued short silk tunic adorned with wine bandhani dots, paired with voluminous coordinated straight-leg silk trousers.
